replies.body:
`SqlSanitizer.jflex` is only used for old semconv

I split out the new `SqlSanitizerWithSummar.jflex` in order to avoid disturbing existing behavior for old semconv.

Will drop `SqlSanitizer.jflex` in 3.0.

The test assertion just shows existing behavior of old semconv (which I'm not making any attempt to improve).

(table isn't captured at all in new semconv)
